name: LH-4810-DEX-02
summary: A robot joint servo-drive board with EtherCAT / CAN FD communication. It accepts a 40–60 V supply and specifies 31 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.

description.en: A robot joint servo-drive board with EtherCAT / CAN FD communication. It accepts a 40–60 V supply and specifies 31 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.
